children: A person familiar with the matter said the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission is investigating Kalshi over suspected wash trading. According to Odaily, Kalshi traders have carried out nearly 1 million trades in the Ethereum futures market since August, with each trade amounting to nearly the same size, drawing attention from federal regulators and traders.

Kalshi said there is no fake trading on the platform and that repeated quotes come from fixed prices posted by market makers. Kalshi co-founder Luana Lopes Lara said it is not unusual to attract large traders into new markets to encourage broader adoption.

title: CFTC Investigates Kalshi Over Suspected Wash Trading in Ethereum Futures Market
